title: Conditional thermodynamic OS/KMS positivity passage contract
question: If finite Q3 transfer-word Gram entries and thermal two-word values converge on every fixed local word list along every declared exhaustion, which OS reflection-positivity and KMS identities pass to the limit, and which additional hypotheses are still required for a common QFT dynamics?

model.finite_os_gram: G^Lambda_ij=Tr(F^Lambda_i* F^Lambda_j)/Z_Lambda for a finite positive-half transfer-word list
hypotheses: For every finite word list and coefficient vector, G^Lambda_ij converges entrywise to G_ij along the chosen exhaustion.
The word embeddings are compatible on overlaps and the limiting Gram form is independent of the exhaustion.
For every local A,B and allowed s, both W^Lambda_AB(s) and W^Lambda_BA(beta hbar-s) converge to finite limits.
The same beta and Euclidean time convention is used on both sides, and finite KMS cyclicity holds before taking the limit.
model.os_passage: For every finite coefficient vector c, c*Gc=lim_Lambda c*G^Lambda c>=0; hence the limiting word form is positive semidefinite and may be quotiented/completed once overlap null vectors are identified.
model.kms_passage: Equality W^Lambda_AB(s)=W^Lambda_BA(beta hbar-s) plus convergence of both sides implies W_AB(s)=W_BA(beta hbar-s).
model.dynamics_boundary: A positive limiting word form does not by itself provide a common Hamiltonian-derived alpha_t; action intertwining, product/core density, direct Cauchy estimates, exhaustion independence and group law remain separate obligations.

adversarial_review.check: The limit argument uses a fixed finite coefficient vector and entrywise convergence; no uniform operator norm or infinite matrix positivity is inferred without the stated word-wise hypotheses.
The executable fixture uses real rational vectors only as a concrete Gram subcase; the contract itself is stated for complex coefficients and requires the corresponding sesquilinear convergence.
The complement beta*hbar-s and the common beta convention are explicit; finite cyclicity is not replaced by commutativity of A and B.
Two toy exhaustion scales share the same limit in the fixture, but actual Q3 exhaustion independence is an unproved hypothesis and remains open.
Positive semidefinite word forms support a quotient/completion only after overlap compatibility and null-space identification; these are stated conditions, not actual Q3 results.
The contract does not identify finite Hamiltonian actions with one common alpha_t or prove a generator on the limiting carrier.
R353 verifies the exact rational Gram sum-of-squares and KMS fixtures only; convergence and Q3 operator limits remain analytic hypotheses.
No KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or Clay conclusion follows from this conditional passage contract.

qft_interface.closed: The exact logical passage from word-wise finite OS Gram convergence and finite thermal cyclicity to limiting OS positivity and KMS equality is isolated and verified on a reproducible rational fixture.
qft_interface.open: Actual Q3 word-wise convergence, common-word embeddings, exhaustion independence, action intertwining, product/core density, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This is a conditional QFT interface contract only; it supplies no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical-empty reference or mass-gap theorem.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional OS/KMS limit-passage contract. It is not an actual thermodynamic Q3 construction or a Clay result.
next_action: Use this contract as the acceptance test for the actual Q3 all-exhaustion word map: prove a source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform common-word Cauchy estimate and action intertwining; otherwise record the exact route-local obstruction before any common-alpha or GNS-gap promotion.
no_overclaim: The package closes only the conditional limit logic and toy finite fixtures. It does not prove actual Q3 thermodynamic word convergence, a common OS carrier, alpha_t, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or a Clay result.
